candidates.reason: These unit tests directly exercise AsyncCrawlerProcess reactorless shutdown helpers affected by moving logging from signal-handler bodies to loop scheduling; the no-main-task test asserts on the same call_soon_threadsafe path that will now also dispatch the forced-shutdown log.

These subprocess tests exercise both first-signal and second-signal shutdown behavior and assert the exact user-visible messages produced by _log_shutdown and _log_kill, so they are the closest end-to-end coverage for the changed dispatch timing.
